content.comment_body: Hello. Can anyone tell me what is the maximum number of annual timers that can be configured in a program? Is there a limit? I remember reading somewhere that there might be a restriction to 8 annual timers. Thanks in advance.
I am running 24 annual timers in my program.

Dear member, please review the attachment containing an excerpt from the manual along with notes. See the table listing resource requirements for all functions in [product_name]. The number of yearly timers you can use depends on the hardware module type and which other functions and resources are in use within your program.

[article_no] You can have 190 weekly clock timers or 200 yearly clock timers, with a maximum of 200 blocks overall. Using 190 weekly clocks leaves no space for additional blocks. You can easily test this by creating a new program in [product_name] software and adding as many timers as possible – once you reach the maximum, you cannot add more. For example, in [article_no] [product_name], the limit for text blocks is 10.

analysis.insight_summary: Community members are unclear about the exact limit for annual timers in [product_name]. Some users share their own implementation numbers, while others refer to official manuals for more technical details about block and resource limitations. The upper limit seems to depend both on timer type and overall resource use, but system documentation and user interface do not always provide obvious answers, leading to ongoing confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a definitive, clear answer regarding the system limits for annual timers. They expect transparent product documentation and the ability to easily check these limits directly within the software.
